battle.name: 諾曼第
battle.brief: 1944年6月6日登陸之後，艦砲、灘頭與制空權是同一天疊起的三層；內陸的樹籬卻拖慢了一切，沒有連續補給的突破，終會停在公路與壕溝之間。卡面的M4謝爾曼是美軍在西線的骨幹，也是德軍裝甲師在正面最常撞上的對手。

kit.name: 謝爾曼
kit.history: 可靠、好修、數量大，後期 76 公厘與螢火蟲等改裝補穿深。單車對虎常吃虧，師的妥善率則相反。

countries: 諾曼第戰役指1944年6月6日起，盟軍在諾曼第地區對德軍展開的整體作戰，海上部分代號「海王星」，陸上部分代號「霸王」。交戰一方是同盟國的西方戰區：最高統帥艾森豪威爾以歐洲戰區司令部統一指揮英美兩軍，地面作戰初期由蒙哥馬利上將指揮第21集團軍群，下轄英軍第8集團軍與第30軍團、加拿大第1集團軍、加拿大第1裝甲師、捷克獨立裝甲旅與波蘭第1裝甲師；美軍方面由布拉德利中將指揮第1集團軍，第1、第2、第3集團軍則直接歸艾森豪威爾，第3集團軍在7月25日交由巴頓中將接手。6月6日投入灘頭的是五個師：美軍第1與第29步兵師攻奧馬哈，第4步兵師與第101空降師攻猶他，英軍第50師攻金灘，英軍第3師攻劍灘，加拿大第3師攻日諾灘，英軍第6空降師與美軍第82空降師則在內陸空降。另一方是德國：西線裝甲集群與B集團軍群先後由隆美爾、古倫登、莫德爾掌管，第7集團軍在奧斯特費爾德麾下防守海岸至卡昂，第15集團軍由薩爾穆特指揮守住塞納河以北，裝甲方面投入了第1、第2、第9、第10、第12、第17、第21黨衛軍裝甲師以及第116裝甲師，並以民兵與海岸砲台支援。盟軍同時在海空兩面壓制：皇家海軍與美國海軍組成史上規模最大的入侵艦隊，英國戰鬥航空司令部與美國第八航空隊則壟斷諾曼第上空。
countriesEn: The Normandy campaign covers the Allied fighting in Normandy from 6 June 1944 to the end of August: the naval phase was codenamed Neptune and the land phase Overlord. One side was the Western Allies, fighting under a single Allied command. General Dwight D. Eisenhower headed the Supreme Headquarters Allied Expeditionary Force, which controlled the British and American armies together. On the ground Montgomery commanded the 21st Army Group, with the British 8th and 30 Corps, the Canadian 1st Army Group, the Canadian 1st Armoured Division, the Czech Independent Armoured Brigade and the Polish 1st Armoured Division under him. In the American sector Omar Bradley led the 1st Army, while the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Armies reported directly to Eisenhower, and George S. Patton took over the 3rd Army on 25 July. Five divisions went ashore on 6 June: the US 1st and 29th Infantry Divisions at Omaha, the US 4th Infantry Division and 101st Airborne Division at Utah, the British 50th Division on Gold, the British 3rd Division on Sword and the Canadian 3rd Division on Juno, while the British 6th Airborne and the US 82nd Airborne landed inland. The other side was Germany. The Army Group B command passed from Rommel to Guderian and Kluge, and then to Model; the 7th Army under Obstfelder held the coast up to Caen, the 15th Army under Salmuth guarded the line north of the Seine, and the armoured effort included the 1st, 2nd, 9th, 10th, 12th, 17th and 21st SS Panzer Divisions together with the 116th Panzer Division, backed by militia and coastal batteries. The Allies applied pressure at sea and in the air at the same time: Royal Navy and US Navy ships formed the largest invasion fleet ever assembled, while the RAF Fighter Command and the US Eighth Air Force held the skies over Normandy.
people: 關鍵人物方面，盟軍最高統帥艾森豪威爾主持「霸王」計畫的全程，6月6日之後數度飛往前線與各司令官會商，7月更下令把樹籬作戰由「一次只啃一道」改為「一次兩三道」，此舉扭轉了初期的僵滯。第21集團軍群司令蒙哥馬利主持登陸初期的作戰與卡昂一帶的攻勢；美國第1集團軍軍長布拉德利自6月起指揮第1集團軍，8月升任第12集團軍群司令；第3集團軍軍長巴頓於7月下旬接手突破任務，其前線經驗與高速機動風格是「眼鏡蛇」得以奏效的關鍵。英方由參謀總長布魯克在倫敦策動整體戰略，海軍方面由拉姆齊中將統率兩國登陸艦隊；空降作戰中，第101空降師由麥克斯威爾·泰勒、第82空降師由里奇韋、第6空降師由巴恩斯率領；加拿大方面則由第1集團軍群軍長克雷拉爾與第3師師長克拉克主持「燈籠」式的火力支援。德軍的指揮鏈在整場戰役中斷裂重組：隆美爾6月因車隊遇襲被解職，古倫登一度代理B集團軍群，7月底再由莫德爾接掌；第7集團軍的奧斯特費爾德與第15集團軍的薩爾穆特在正面一線應戰，希特勒屢次要求裝甲師寸土不讓，並把戰局成敗與裝甲部隊的表現直接掛鈎；德國空軍的戰鬥指揮官在7月30日「黑色星期四」之後遭撤換。
peopleEn: Among the decisive figures, Eisenhower ran Operation Overlord from beginning to end, flying to the front repeatedly to confer with his commanders, and in July he overruled the hedge-to-hedge approach, allowing two or three hedgerows to be taken at a time instead of one, which turned around the early stalemate. Montgomery commanded the 21st Army Group and the fighting around Caen. Omar Bradley led the US 1st Army from June and took the 12th Army Group in August, while George S. Patton took over the breakthrough with the 3rd Army in late July, his front-line experience and preference for speed being the key to the success of Cobra. On the British side the Chief of the Imperial General Staff, Alan Brooke, drove the grand strategy from London, and Admiral Bertram Ramsay commanded the two navies' landing fleet. In the airborne operations Major-General Maxwell Taylor led the 101st, Major-General Matthew Ridgway the 82nd and Major-General Richard Barnes the 6th Airborne Division; in Canada Major-General Harry Crerar and Lieutenant-General L. F. Clark directed the artillery preparation called 'Lamp'. The German chain of command was repeatedly broken and rebuilt: Rommel was removed in June after his staff car was ambushed, Guderian briefly took Army Group B, and Model succeeded Kluge at the end of July. Obstfelder and Salmuth held the front line, while Hitler repeatedly demanded that the panzer divisions hold every position and tied the fate of the battle directly to their performance. The Luftwaffe's fighter command was relieved after 'Black Thursday' on 30 July 1944.
kits: 卡面的M4謝爾曼是美軍在西線的絕對骨幹。它1942年量產，乘員五人，汽油發動機搭配三速自動變速箱，早期裝75毫米M3戰車炮，1943年後陸續換裝76毫米M3及長身管高初速炮，穿深因此提高不少；1942年型採用小負重輪，履帶容易鬆脫，懸吊與最終傳動常出故障，1943年中期換上濕式傳動後妥善率明顯改善。產量方面，1942年約產1,300輛，1943年約12,700輛，1944年約13,300輛，戰時總產接近49,000輛，是二戰產量最大的中型坦克之一；到1944年6月，美軍在西線可用的M4已接近五千輛。諾曼第的正規交戰雙方裝備懸殊：德軍的虎式裝88毫米戰車炮，豹式雖火力強但裝甲傾斜角度差、車室狹窄且常拋錨，斐迪南式裝150毫米臼炮，突擊砲三型與四型則屬防禦性反坦克武器；盟軍除了M4謝爾曼，還有英製邱吉爾、克倫威爾、巡洋坦克Mk VI，以及專門對付虎式與豹式的坦克獵手，炮兵方面大量使用M10與M18自走砲，配屬反坦克砲、單兵反坦克武器與航空支援。海空方面，登陸當日盟軍投入逾五千艘登陸與運輸船隻、軍艦約百餘艘，另有兩座人工港「桑樹」與PLUTO海底輸油管；空中則有P-47、P-51「野馬」、颶風與噴火戰鬥機，並以滑翔機與空投把補給送進灘頭。
kitsEn: The M4 Sherman on the card face was the absolute backbone of the American army in the west. It entered production in 1942, carried a crew of five, and used a petrol engine with a three-speed automatic transmission. Early vehicles carried the 75 mm M3 gun; from 1943 many were refitted with the 76 mm M3 and later the long high-velocity 76 mm, which improved penetration considerably. The 1942 models ran on small idler wheels, their tracks went loose, and suspension and final drives failed often; the wet transmission fitted from the middle of 1943 made a clear difference to reliability. Output was about 1,300 tanks in 1942, some 12,700 in 1943 and about 13,300 in 1944, with wartime production approaching 49,000 vehicles, which made it one of the most numerous medium tanks of the war; by June 1944 the US army had close to five thousand M4s available in the west. The equipment sides in the open fighting of Normandy were sharply uneven. The Tiger carried an 88 mm gun; the Panther had punch but poor sloping, a cramped fighting compartment and a habit of breaking down; the Elephant carried a 150 mm howitzer; and the StuG III and StuG IV were defensive anti-tank weapons. Beside the M4 the Allies fielded the Churchill, the Cromwell, the Cruiser Mk VI and the Tank Destroyer built to kill Tigers and Panthers, backed by massed artillery, M10 and M18 tank destroyers, man-portable anti-tank weapons and air support. At sea and in the air, more than five thousand landing and transport vessels including a hundred-odd warships went into the landings, alongside the two Mulberry harbours and the PLUTO fuel pipelines, while P-47s, P-51 Mustangs, Typhoons and Spitfires provided the air cover and gliders and supply drops fed the beachhead.
tactics: 6月6日的戰術分三層：海軍以數千艘登陸艇把五個師送上五個灘頭，兩棲部隊在前方灘頭排成橫線，摧毀德軍據點；傘兵在凌晨空降，阻斷內陸主要公路；空軍在整個登陸日持續低空掃射與轟炸灘頭。真正的難題在內陸：諾曼第是樹籬地形，道路狹窄下陷，視野往往只有數十公尺，6月的前三週，第1步兵師在三週內只推進約六公里，代價卻極大，盟軍因此在7月一度被指過度保守。7月8日「燈籠」作戰以英加聯軍攻佔卡昂，7月18日「好獵」作戰在卡昂東南展開城市戰，7月25日巴頓的「眼鏡蛇」以兩百多輛坦克配合航空火力在聖洛撕開缺口，8月8日「藍外套」作戰則在阿夫朗什方向打穿德軍縱深。德軍這邊的戰術缺陷同樣致命：裝甲師缺乏步兵協同與工兵支援，燃料與反坦克砲不足，豹式的短管炮在遠距離無能為力，而德國把寶貴燃料儲存在縱深，反而讓盟軍空軍與游擊隊有機可乘。8月之後英美改以「犁田式」推進，一次打通數百公尺縱深，坦克掩護步兵，並把後勤線逐步向前拖。
tacticsEn: The tactics of 6 June had three layers. The navy lifted five divisions onto five beaches in several thousand landing craft, the assault companies went in along the front of the beach to knock out the German positions, paratroopers dropped in the small hours to cut the main roads inland, and the air force flew low-level strikes and bombardment over the beaches all day. The real difficulty lay inland. Normandy was bocage country, with narrow sunken roads and sightlines of a few tens of metres, and in the first three weeks the US 1st Infantry Division advanced only about six kilometres while paying heavily for it, which in July brought the Allies a charge of undue caution. Operation Charnwood on 8 July took Caen with British and Canadian troops; Operation Goodwood on 18 July fought through the city to the south-east of it; on 25 July Patton's Cobra tore a gap at Saint-Lô with more than two hundred tanks and close air support; and on 8 August Bluecoat broke through towards the Avranches salient. German tactical shortcomings were just as fatal: the panzer divisions lacked infantry co-operation and engineer support, ran short of fuel and anti-tank guns, and the Panther's short gun was useless at range, while Germany stored its fuel in depth where Allied air power and the resistance could reach it. After August the British and Americans changed to ploughing advances, clearing several hundred metres of depth in one bite, tanks covering infantry, and logistics moved forward step by step.
data: 可查的數字可以勾出戰役的規模與代價。時間上，登陸日為1944年6月6日，戰役以8月25日巴黎解放為界，前後約八十天。兵力上，6月6日約十五萬六千人登陸，其中空降約二萬三千人，掩護兵力由逾五千艘艦船與約一萬四千架次的空軍出動構成；至8月，盟軍在戰役中傷亡約二十一萬人，其中空軍人員約三萬七千人，地面部隊陣亡約四萬人上下。德軍方面，整場戰役損失約四十五萬人，其中被俘約二十萬、陣亡與負傷約二十四萬，數字各家統計互有出入。法萊斯包圍戰一役即有一萬名德軍陣亡、五萬人被俘，遺棄與被毀的車輛達三萬輛之數。推進距離上，7月8日卡昂解放時盟軍自海岸線只推進約三十公里，8月21日法萊斯合攏時已推進約兩百五十公里，8月25日裝甲先頭部隊抵達巴黎。裝備產能上，M4謝爾曼在1942至1945年間總產約四萬九千輛，1944年6月美軍西線可用約五千輛。補給上，8月26日開通的「紅球快線」以約六千輛卡車每日運送上萬噸物資，單程要跑四五百公里。城鎮爭奪的細部傷亡數字，如卡昂市區英軍的陣亡人數，史料記載多有出入，難有定論。
dataEn: The surviving figures sketch the scale and the cost. In time, the landing day was 6 June 1944 and the campaign ran to 25 August with the liberation of Paris, about eighty days in all. In men, some 156,000 troops went ashore on 6 June, of whom roughly 23,000 came in by air, supported by more than five thousand ships and about 14,000 air sorties; by August Allied casualties in the campaign were around 209,000, including about 37,000 air force personnel and roughly 40,000 ground dead. On the German side the campaign cost about 450,000 men, of whom some 200,000 were taken prisoner and around 240,000 killed or wounded; the sources differ on these totals. The Falaise pocket alone cost about 10,000 German dead and 50,000 prisoners, with some 30,000 vehicles destroyed or abandoned. In distance, the Allies had advanced only about thirty kilometres from the coast when Caen fell on 8 July, but by the closing of the pocket at Falaise on 21 August they had driven some 250 kilometres, and armoured columns reached Paris on 25 August. In production, about 49,000 M4 Shermans were built between 1942 and 1945, and the US army had some five thousand in the west by June 1944. On logistics, the Red Ball Express opened on 26 August and moved over ten thousand tons a day with about six thousand trucks running four to five hundred kilometres each way. Detailed casualty figures for individual towns, such as British losses in Caen itself, are much disputed and cannot be settled.
cause: 打起來的起因是多層的。第一層是戰略必要：蘇聯在東線連年血戰，盟軍必須在1944年開闢西線戰場，分擔德軍兵力並打擊德國工業，邱吉爾則力主趁機打通歐洲大陸。第二層是教訓的累積：1942年迪耶普的失敗證明正面強攻設防港口代價太高，1943年西西里與義大利的登陸提供了可複製的兩棲作戰程序，1944年英美在情報、欺敵與空海協同上的準備遠超以往。第三層是地理的取捨：英吉利海峽最窄處約三十四公里，但要找一個能同時容納五個師登陸、海灘坡度可攀、港口可用而德軍又能據守灘頭的地方並不容易，諾曼第符合大部分條件。第四層是德軍的自信與盟軍的欺敵：德軍在1944年仍相信西線守得住，並企圖以V-1飛彈報復倫敦；盟軍則在加萊方向維持一支實際不存在的集團軍群，保留「諾曼第只是佯攻」的假象，把德軍裝甲師調離真正的主攻方向。
causeEn: The reasons for the fighting lie on several levels. First there was strategic necessity: the Soviet Union was bleeding in the east, and the Allies had to open a front in the west in 1944 to tie down German forces and strike at German industry, while Churchill pressed for the opening of a mainland European front. Second came the accumulation of lessons: the failure at Dieppe in 1942 showed what a frontal assault on a defended port cost, the landings in Sicily and Italy in 1943 supplied a repeatable amphibious procedure, and in 1944 British and American preparation in intelligence, deception and air-sea co-operation went far beyond anything earlier. Third was the geographical compromise: the narrowest point of the English Channel is about thirty-four kilometres wide, but it was hard to find a coast that would take five divisions, had beaches that could be climbed, gave usable ports, and was at the same time defensible by the Germans; Normandy met most of those conditions. Fourth were German confidence and Allied deception: Germany still believed in 1944 that the west could be held and looked to the V-1 to strike back at London, while the Allies kept a fictitious army group in the Pas-de-Calais, preserving the impression that Normandy was a feint and drawing the German panzer divisions away from the real axis of attack.
impact: 諾曼第的後果遠超出戰場本身。第一，西線的天平就此傾斜，德國B集團軍群折損數十個師，第12集團軍群與第21集團軍群在法國北部會師，德軍在西線再無成建制的野戰力量，1944年12月阿登堡反擊因此只能以殘缺兵力出發。第二，盟軍的攻勢轉入追擊，9月起法國北部與比利時大部次第解放，解放的節奏由諾曼第連續突破一路推到巴黎，帶動法國抵抗運動接管城市、戴高樂的臨時政府建立。第三，空戰與工業面的影響更為長久，7月30日的「黑色星期四」之後德國空軍在西北歐喪失大量戰機，制空權不再有爭議；V-1與V-2的飛彈戰役則催生了盟軍的攔截網與導引雷達。武器史上，M4謝爾曼以近五萬輛的產量成為盟軍在中歐地面戰的骨幹，76毫米長身管炮與穿甲彈讓它從迴避獅式虎式改為可以正面對抗豹式，而它的高車身、汽油機與耗油也同時留下了代價。諾曼第還定型了現代兩棲作戰的樣板：空降、灘頭、艦砲火力與人工港的配合，之後在安特衛普、士林根與沖繩被反覆搬演。
impactEn: The consequences of Normandy reached well beyond the battlefield. First the balance on the western front tipped: Army Group B lost dozens of divisions, the 12th and 21st Army Groups met in northern France, and Germany had no formed field force left in the west, which is why the Ardennes counterstroke of December 1944 could only be launched with a crippled army. Second the Allied offensive turned into a pursuit: from September the north of France and most of Belgium came free, the pace set at Normandy carried through to Paris, and the resistance took over the towns as de Gaulle's provisional government was established. Third the effect on air power and industry was longer lasting: after 'Black Thursday' on 30 July the Luftwaffe lost large numbers of fighters over north-west Europe and the issue of air supremacy was settled, while the V-1 and V-2 campaigns produced the Allied interceptor network and the guidance radar. In the history of weapons the M4 Sherman, with output near fifty thousand, became the backbone of Allied ground warfare in central Europe: the long 76 mm gun and its ammunition turned it from a tank that avoided Tigers and Panthers into one that could take Panthers head-on, while its high hull, petrol engine and thirst remained its weaknesses. Normandy also fixed the modern template of amphibious warfare, with airborne, beachhead, naval gunfire and artificial harbours in combination, replayed afterwards at Antwerp, on the Scheldt and at Okinawa.
result: 結局是盟軍完全勝利，德軍西線被重創。6月6日五個灘頭一天之內被突破，7月8日卡昂解放，7月25日「眼鏡蛇」撕開德軍正面，8月8日突破阿夫朗什突出部，8月12日至21日法萊斯包圍戰把德軍第7與第15集團軍夾在袋中，約五萬人放下武器，第12黨衛軍「希特勒青年」裝甲師在此重創，8月19日巴黎起義，8月25日盟軍部隊進入巴黎，戰役以德軍西線崩潰收場。代價方面，盟軍傷亡約二十一萬人，其中相當部分集中在6月6日；德軍損失約四十五萬人，被俘者大多被送往戰俘營。戰後德軍在西線只剩殘缺師團退回本土，第15、第7、第5集團軍相繼被解體，盟軍的補給線終於能從諾曼第的灘頭直接通向巴黎，準備下一階段向德國本土推進。卡面上的M4謝爾曼在這場戰役中既是最不擅長單挑虎式的量產工具，也是最終贏得整條戰線的中堅，它的76毫米改裝與妥善率改善，都發生在這幾個月裡。
resultEn: The outcome was an outright Allied victory and the crippling of the German army in the west. Five beaches were turned over in a single day on 6 June; Caen fell on 8 July; Cobra tore open the German front on 25 July; Bluecoat broke out towards the Avranches salient on 8 August; and the pocket at Falaise between 12 and 21 August closed on the German 7th and 15th Armies, some fifty thousand men surrendering their weapons, with the 12th SS Panzer Division Hitlerjugend shattered there. Paris rose on 19 August and Allied troops entered it on the 25th, and the campaign closed with the collapse of the German west. The cost fell on both sides: some 209,000 Allied casualties, a large share of them on 6 June, and about 450,000 German losses, most of the prisoners being sent to camps. Afterwards only broken German divisions fell back to the homeland, the 15th, 7th and 5th Armies were dissolved in turn, and the Allied line of supply could run straight from the Normandy beaches to Paris in preparation for the drive into Germany proper. The M4 Sherman on the card face was both the mass-produced tool least suited to single-handed duels with Tigers and the backbone that finally won the front, and its 76 mm refits and improved reliability were completed within these very months.
